title: Inter are down two at Bologna — Pavard out with an adductor strain
caption:
Inter lost a second starter this week. The club said Friday that Benjamin Pavard has a strain in his right adductors, per Inter.it, with no return date given. FCInterNews reports at least 20 days; Inter have published no timeline. Cristian Chivu says Lautaro Martínez will probably be back after the November break. Inter play at Bologna today, 12:00 PM ET / 18:00 CEST.
